From ecb6237fa397b7b810d798ad19322eca466dbab1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Julien Grall <jgrall@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2022 11:30:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] x86/xen: Remove undefined behavior in setup_features()

1 << 31 is undefined. So switch to 1U << 31.

Fixes: 5ead97c84fa7 ("xen: Core Xen implementation")
Signed-off-by: Julien Grall <jgrall@amazon.com>
Reviewed-by: Juergen Gross <jgross@suse.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220617103037.57828-1-julien@xen.org
Signed-off-by: Juergen Gross <jgross@suse.com>

diff --git a/drivers/xen/features.c b/drivers/xen/features.c
index 7b591443833c..87f1828d40d5 100644
--- a/drivers/xen/features.c
+++ b/drivers/xen/features.c
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ void xen_setup_features(void)
 		if (HYPERVISOR_xen_version(XENVER_get_features, &fi) < 0)
 			break;
 		for (j = 0; j < 32; j++)
-			xen_features[i * 32 + j] = !!(fi.submap & 1<<j);
+			xen_features[i * 32 + j] = !!(fi.submap & 1U << j);
 	}
 
 	if (xen_pv_domain()) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/xen/features.c`**
- The line of code that previously used `1 << 31` has been modified to `1U << 31`. This change ensures that the operation does not invoke undefined behavior, as shifting a signed integer can lead to issues when the shift exceeds the bit-width of the type.

### Relationships
- The modification in `features.c` addresses a potential bug related to undefined behavior in the original implementation. The change is directly linked to the previous commit identified by the hash `5ead97c84fa7`, which introduced the original code. By switching to an unsigned integer shift, the patch improves the robustness of the code while maintaining the intended functionality.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
-			xen_features[i * 32 + j] = !!(fi.submap & 1<<j);
```
Reason:
The expression `1 << 31` uses a signed integer shift operation, which can lead to undefined behavior when the shift exceeds the bit-width of the signed integer type. This can cause unexpected behavior or crashes on certain platforms.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+			xen_features[i * 32 + j] = !!(fi.submap & 1U << j);
```
Reason:
By changing `1 << j` to `1U << j`, the code uses an unsigned integer shift operation, which avoids the undefined behavior associated with shifting a signed integer. This ensures consistent and defined behavior across different platforms.
